module: Knowledge clone current snapshot and parser coordinates

findings.summary: CloneChunk drops ContentRevision while preserving edited Content and parser offsets; Wiki and summary treat cloned edited bodies as untouched parser chunks and can discard a contained-range independent body.
findings.provenance: Root identified candidate after Wiki current-chunk fix 46396e6df. Verified through actual cloneKnowledge persisted in temporary SQLite and actual reconstructContent/getSummary capture.

before.observed: Source revision 3/4 becomes 0/0 on cloned chunks; both Wiki and summary lose complete second independent body at source range50:90 contained in0:100.

temporary_fix_validation.change: Only copy source ContentRevision into target current row.

semantic_constraints: Preserve the exact current revision: DocumentChunkMetadata.IsQuestionCurrent uses the value, so resetting every edited row to1 would alter generated-question freshness.
Historical chunk_revisions rows are not copied; current content lives on Chunk and the next destination edit records its own prior snapshot.
SourceContent also preserved after independent reproduction of subsequent parent rebuild loss.
findings.fix: Preserve source ContentRevision exactly on the cloned current chunk; copied generated-question freshness metadata retains the same meaning. No revision-history rows are copied.

findings.summary: Clone omits immutable SourceContent; a later child edit may apply parser offsets against the already edited parent body, even if ContentRevision is preserved.

before.observed: Actual cloneKnowledge followed by UpdateDocumentChunk expects parent AABBB but leaves AA456789. Isolated revision-only overlay improves to AA6789 but still loses the new body, proving SourceContent is independently necessary.

temporary_fix_validation.change: Preserve ContentRevision and SourceContent and rewrite SourceContent copied image references.

findings.fix: Copy the immutable parser SourceContent snapshot and rewrite its embedded images using the same completed old/new URL cache as Content. This keeps subsequent clone edits based on the original parent text while using destination image objects.

findings.summary: Clone image URL replacement changes parser-base rune length while retaining source StartAt/EndAt. Later child edits overwrite the copied image URL; revision0 Wiki/summary can lose repeated body text through inexact-overlap fallback.
findings.provenance: Root requested adjacent clone-to-edit investigation before committing R3/R4. Confirmed against current +5-line snapshot fix AND HEAD without snapshot fix, using actual cloneKnowledge, persisted SQLite chunks and actual UpdateDocumentChunk. Then permanent tests also reproduce actual Wiki and getSummary loss.

observed: Revision0 repeated Chinese text loses complete repeated blocks in both Wiki and summary; copied body rune length no longer equals stored interval.

findings.fix: Collect actual image replacements in exact immutable parser bases, translate document-global rune coordinates consistently and deduplicate occurrences visible in overlapping parents/children. Keep current edited bodies and exact revision values. Partial URL boundaries use the same proportional slices of the replacement in both adjacent chunks; do not restore old body text. Perform translation before any CreateChunks; ambiguous contradictory bases return error through existing cleanup.
test_design: Actual clone->edit with unedited source and prior edited sibling; nonzero document origin and Unicode prefix.

Actual revision0 clone->Wiki/getSummary with repeated text, repeated image URLs, overlapping parent windows and sub-12-rune child overlap; verify exact expected global offsets, trusted lengths and parent-relative substring equality.
Hand-derived longer Unicode and shorter URL boundary projections including a boundary inside the URL; image-caption body is rewritten without pretending its metadata range is a parser base.
Actual contradictory source coordinate fixture fails before chunk persistence, marks clone failed, cleans both copied objects, and retains both source chunks.

review_followup.candidate: Root review identified that overlap-only old-text agreement does not prove identical replacement; a later match can extend beyond previous end.
review_followup.reproduction: Actual cloneKnowledge with two valid URL strings in intersecting exact source windows; A query contains B prefix. All shared old text agrees, but different copied URLs must not be merged.

before.observed: Old unique loop returns success instead of rejecting ambiguous copied image coordinates.

review_followup.fix: Only identical start/end/old/new records deduplicate; partial/contained conflicting replacements fail closed through existing copied-object cleanup. Permanent test verifies failed state, no destination chunks and both copied objects cleaned.
review_followup.same_range_different_new_invariant: Current immutable urlCache map[string]string maps each exact JSON-decoded UTF-8 source URL to one destination string, so identical interval+old implies identical new; still explicitly check new to express dedup invariant.

findings.summary: Sequential URL replacements may rewrite a destination URL again when it equals/contains another source URL; cloned body can point at a different image than copied ImageInfo.

before.observed: Original helper maps long-source.png -> a.png and a.png -> x.png, yielding x.png x.png instead of a.png x.png. Overlay restores only HEAD helper while compiling current permanent regression.

findings.fix: Use a single leftmost/longest strings.Replacer pass so only source occurrences are replaced; coordinate collector follows the same matching rule.

limits: Current revision and parser base copied; historical revision rows remain on the source. No real user data migrated.

Coordinate transforms are inferred only from exact immutable parser bases. Existing synthetic-header or legacy imprecise coordinates are not claimed repaired. Conflicting exact image intervals fail before chunk persistence and release copied objects.
